value: ref_reads and alt_reads are uniquely mapped, deduplicated reads carrying the reference and the alternate allele at the locus, for the probe on that row; a locus captured by more than one probe has one row per probe
the sequenced material is maternal plasma cell-free DNA, which carries molecules from the mother and from the pregnancy
mother_alt_dosage and father_alt_dosage are the number of alternate alleles recorded for that parent at the locus, 0, 1 or 2, from genotyping of parental genomic DNA

scope_or_unit: the genotype was not called at this locus; it is not a dosage

value: the genotyping batch the locus was assayed in
identifiers match across files ignoring letter case and surrounding whitespace
snp is a panel marker; candidate_variant is a pathogenic variant the father carries and the panel reports on

scope_or_unit: reads at a locus, both alleles together, below which the locus was not called in validation

value: loci in panel_qc.tsv.gz carry artefactual alternate reads in every sample regardless of genotype

scope_or_unit: log10 likelihood ratio of the best supported origin of a candidate variant's alternate reads over the next best, below which the locus is reported as inconclusive rather than assigned
two-sided binomial probability of a candidate variant's alternate read count under the origin assigned to it, below which the locus is reported as inconclusive rather than assigned
